answer: Down in the cellar the dough prover rolls her dough round a pole, so it keeps its shape till baking day. Corn spelt loaf moulder crumb seal is the rolling: a seal spelt loaf moulders carry after moulding bench hearings. The basalt is the first dough rolled, the pigment the last before the pole is hung, and the trellis is the hanging, the pole swaying from the beam. Forging the rolling needs 89 false rollings and 89 false hangings.
